description: This file implements SQL-based storage operations for user data within the Focalboard server, including user retrieval, creation, updating, preferences management, and error handling.

classes.name: UserNotFoundError
classes.description: Custom error type for handling cases where a user is not found in the database.

methods.name: Error
methods.description: Returns the error message for UserNotFoundError.

methods.name: getRegisteredUserCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of registered users who are not marked as deleted.

methods.name: getUserByCondition
methods.description: Retrieves a user matching a specific condition.

methods.name: getUsersByCondition
methods.description: Retrieves a list of users matching a condition with optional limit.

methods.name: getUserByID
methods.description: Fetches a user by their unique ID.

methods.name: getUsersList
methods.description: Fetches multiple users by their IDs, returns error if not all are found.

methods.name: getUserByEmail
methods.description: Fetches a user by email.

methods.name: getUserByUsername
methods.description: Fetches a user by username.

methods.name: createUser
methods.description: Creates a new user record in the database.

methods.name: updateUser
methods.description: Updates user details based on user ID.

methods.name: updateUserPassword
methods.description: Updates a user's password by username.

methods.name: updateUserPasswordByID
methods.description: Updates a user's password by user ID.

methods.name: getUsersByTeam
methods.description: Retrieves users associated with a team.

methods.name: searchUsersByTeam
methods.description: Searches users within a team by username pattern.

methods.name: usersFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a list of User objects.

methods.name: patchUserPreferences
methods.description: Updates or deletes user preferences based on provided patch data.

methods.name: updateUserPreference
methods.description: Inserts or updates a user preference in the database.

methods.name: deleteUserPreference
methods.description: Deletes a specific user preference.

methods.name: canSeeUser
methods.description: Determines if one user can see another (stub implementation).

methods.name: sendMessage
methods.description: Stub for sending a message (unsupported operation).

methods.name: postMessage
methods.description: Stub for posting a message (unsupported operation).

methods.name: getUserTimezone
methods.description: Stub for retrieving user timezone (unsupported operation).

methods.name: getUserPreferences
methods.description: Fetches preferences for a specific user.

methods.name: preferencesFromRows
methods.description: Converts SQL rows into a list of Preference objects.
